def createparser():
    """Create an argument parser for the pysemver command-line interface."""
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog='pysemver',
        description='Semantic Versioning command-line tool'
    )
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest='command')

    # bump_major command
    parser_bump_major = subparsers.add_parser('bump_major', help='Bump major version')
    parser_bump_major.add_argument('version', help='Version string')

    # bump_minor command
    parser_bump_minor = subparsers.add_parser('bump_minor', help='Bump minor version')
    parser_bump_minor.add_argument('version', help='Version string')

    # bump_patch command
    parser_bump_patch = subparsers.add_parser('bump_patch', help='Bump patch version')
    parser_bump_patch.add_argument('version', help='Version string')

    # bump_prerelease command
    parser_bump_prerelease = subparsers.add_parser('bump_prerelease', help='Bump prerelease version')
    parser_bump_prerelease.add_argument('version', help='Version string')
    parser_bump_prerelease.add_argument('--token', default='rc', help='Token for prerelease')

    # bump_build command
    parser_bump_build = subparsers.add_parser('bump_build', help='Bump build version')
    parser_bump_build.add_argument('version', help='Version string')
    parser_bump_build.add_argument('--token', default='build', help='Token for build')

    # replace command
    parser_replace = subparsers.add_parser('replace', help='Replace version components')
    parser_replace.add_argument('version', help='Version string')
    parser_replace.add_argument('--major', type=int, help='New major version')
    parser_replace.add_argument('--minor', type=int, help='New minor version')
    parser_replace.add_argument('--patch', type=int, help='New patch version')
    parser_replace.add_argument('--prerelease', help='New prerelease')
    parser_replace.add_argument('--build', help='New build')

    # compare command
    parser_compare = subparsers.add_parser('compare', help='Compare two versions')
    parser_compare.add_argument('ver1', help='First version')
    parser_compare.add_argument('ver2', help='Second version')

    return parser


def process(args):
    """Process command-line arguments and execute the appropriate command."""
    if args.command == 'bump_major':
        print(bump_major(args.version))
    elif args.command == 'bump_minor':
        print(bump_minor(args.version))
    elif args.command == 'bump_patch':
        print(bump_patch(args.version))
    elif args.command == 'bump_prerelease':
        print(bump_prerelease(args.version, token=args.token))
    elif args.command == 'bump_build':
        print(bump_build(args.version, token=args.token))
    elif args.command == 'replace':
        kwargs = {k: v for k, v in vars(args).items() if k not in ('command', 'version') and v is not None}
        print(replace(args.version, **kwargs))
    elif args.command == 'compare':
        result = compare(args.ver1, args.ver2)
        print(result)
    else:
        raise SystemExit("Please specify a command")


def main(argv=None):
    """Main entry point for the pysemver command-line interface."""
    parser = createparser()
    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
    process(args)
